# BottomSheet

Figma: [06c. BottomSheet](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-933) · Family: 06 Navigation · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-06-14

A modal sheet that slides up for focused, contextual tasks. A composable shell - drag handle, header, swappable content slot, footer - with a library of ready content (Text · List · Summary · Amount · Form · Empty) across LTR + RTL.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/bottom-sheet/reference.png`

### DragHandle

The grabber pill at the top of a BottomSheet that signals the sheet can be dragged down to dismiss.

Level: atom · Part of: BottomSheet

Use when:
- Top of any BottomSheet that is dismissible (BottomSheet showHandle on)
- Bottom-sheet menu and Action sheet patterns

Don't use when:
- Modal or Drawer: they have no drag-to-dismiss
- Blocking sheets that must not be dismissed: hide it with showHandle off

Accessibility: Decorative; always provide an accessible close or cancel action since drag is not available to all users.

_No properties._

### SheetHeader

Shared overlay header with title, optional subtitle and optional close X, reused by BottomSheet, Modal and Drawer.

Level: molecule · Contains: IconButton · Part of: BottomSheet, Modal, Drawer

Use when:
- Header of a BottomSheet, Modal or Drawer (toggle via showHeader on the shell)
- Hiding the close for destructive confirms (showClose off)

Don't use when:
- Screen header: use AppBar
- Titling a region in a page: use Section

Accessibility: Title is the dialog's accessible name (aria-labelledby); close button labelled Close / إغلاق.

### Sheet Content / Text

Ready content block for overlay slots: heading, paragraphs and an inline link. The default Content of BottomSheet, used for explanatory sheets such as 'About the developer'.

Level: molecule · Part of: BottomSheet, Modal, Drawer

Use when:
- Explaining a term, fee or developer in a BottomSheet or Modal
- Short informational sheet with one confirm action

Don't use when:
- Long legal text: use a full page
- Breakdowns with amounts: use Sheet Content / Summary

Accessibility: Keep heading order under the sheet title; the link must be a real link with descriptive text.

### SheetFooter

Shared overlay action area: primary button with optional secondary and an optional overflow menu, stacked (mobile sheets, modals) or in a row (drawers).

Level: molecule · Contains: Button, IconButton · Part of: BottomSheet, Modal, Drawer

Use when:
- Confirm / Cancel actions at the bottom of a BottomSheet or Modal (Layout=Stacked)
- Drawer footer with Apply, Reset and overflow (Layout=Row)

Don't use when:
- Page-level button groups: use ButtonGroup
- Pure navigation drawers: turn showFooter off on Drawer

Accessibility: Primary action first in reading order; reserve the home-indicator safe area; overflow needs an aria-label.

### BottomSheet

Mobile modal surface that slides up from the bottom over a scrim for one short, focused task without leaving the screen: drag handle, SheetHeader, swappable Content slot and SheetFooter. The default overlay for Safqah mobile.

Level: organism · Contains: DragHandle, SheetHeader, SheetFooter, Sheet Content / Text, Sheet Content / List, Sheet Content / Summary, Sheet Content / Amount, Sheet Content / Form, Sheet Content / Empty

Use when:
- Confirming an investment or reviewing a summary before paying
- Entering an amount or a short form tied to the current screen
- Explaining a term or developer in context
- Re-prompt or permission reminders on mobile

Don't use when:
- Centered blocking confirm on desktop/web: use Modal, or Dialog for a one-line confirm
- Side panel for navigation or filters: use Drawer
- A floating list of commands: use Menu (or Action sheet on mobile)
- Long or multi-step flows: use a full page with Stepper

Accessibility: role=dialog with aria-modal, labelled by the SheetHeader title; trap focus and restore it on close; provide a close or cancel besides drag; never stack two sheets.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

BottomSheet is a modal surface that slides up from the bottom edge for a focused, contextual task without leaving the screen. It is not a fixed set of layouts - it is a composable shell (handle · header · content slot · footer) that you fill with any content, plus a starter library of ready content components.

### When to use

- A short, focused task tied to the current screen - confirm, pick, enter a value, review a summary.
- Content that benefits from staying in context rather than navigating to a full page.
- Mobile-first flows where a bottom-anchored surface is reachable by thumb.

### When not to use

- Long or multi-step flows - use a full page or a Stepper instead.
- Critical blocking decisions on desktop - prefer a centered Dialog (05h).

### Live preview

### Atomic architecture

BottomSheet is built the same way as Select: small atoms compose into a shell, and the body is an open slot. Changing an atom cascades to every sheet that uses it.

### Atoms - building blocks

- DragHandle - the grabber pill that signals the sheet is draggable/dismissable.
- SheetHeader - title + optional subtitle + optional close. Booleans: showSubtitle, showClose. 2 directions.
- SheetFooter - primary + optional secondary action button stack. Boolean: showSecondary. 2 directions.

### Shell - the composed organism

- BottomSheet - rounded container that stacks DragHandle + SheetHeader + a Content slot + SheetFooter, each togglable (showHandle / showHeader / showFooter).

### Content - swappable slot fillers

- Six ready content components (Text · List · Summary · Amount · Form · Empty) drop into the Content slot - or swap in any component you build.

> **Info:** The Content slot is a nested instance named “Content”. Right-click it → Swap instance to drop in any content - that is what makes the sheet infinitely extensible rather than a finite list of types.

### Anatomy

Top to bottom, every sheet is the same five-part stack over a dimmed scrim. Parts are optional via booleans.

- Scrim - dimmed overlay (bg/overlay) behind the sheet; tapping it dismisses.
- Container - rounded top corners (Radius/24), bg/base, docked to the bottom edge.
- DragHandle - centered grabber; toggle with showHandle.
- Header (SheetHeader) - title, optional subtitle, close; toggle with showHeader.
- Content slot - the swappable body; fills the available width.
- Footer (SheetFooter) - action buttons; toggle with showFooter.

### Content library

Six ready content components drop into the BottomSheet Content slot - or use them on their own. Swap any of these (or your own component) into a sheet to compose it for the job at hand. Each is built from the system’s own components.

Text

Heading, paragraphs, and an inline link. For informational and explanatory sheets.

List

Rows with icon, title/subtitle, and a Tag status chip. For pickers and selection.

Summary

KeyValue rows with a Divider and an emphasized total. For breakdowns and receipts.

Amount

Input Amount field with a Slider. For entering an investment or transfer value.

Form

Input and TextArea fields. For collecting structured data in the sheet.

Empty state

The EmptyState component. For zero-data and first-run cases.

### Composition & slots

Build any sheet by toggling the chrome and swapping the content - no need for a fixed list of sheet “types”.

### Chrome toggles

- showHandle - show or hide the drag grabber.
- showHeader - show or hide the SheetHeader (which itself toggles showSubtitle and showClose).
- showFooter - show or hide the SheetFooter (which toggles showSecondary for one- vs two-button stacks).

### Content slot

- Set the Content property to swap the body - the 6 library components are offered as presets.
- Not limited to the library - swap in any component (a custom card, a chart, an onboarding step).
- The default slot is a placeholder (Text); it is meant to be replaced.

> **Info:** Set the Content property (or right-click the Content layer → Swap instance) to drop in List, Summary, Amount, Form, Empty, or your own component. That is what makes BottomSheet open-ended instead of finite.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

Every part ships in both directions. The Direction axis flips the chrome; the content carries its own Direction.

LTR

Left-to-right, IBM Plex Sans. Close on the trailing (right) side; footer reads left-to-right.

RTL

Right-to-left, Noto Sans Arabic. Header mirrors (close on the left), content right-aligns.

- Set the shell Direction to flip handle, header, and footer together.
- Match the Content instance’s own Direction (or swap to the RTL content variant) so the body mirrors too.

### Behavior & dismissal

How the sheet appears, sizes, and goes away.

- Scrim - a dimmed overlay (bg/overlay) sits behind the sheet; tapping it dismisses.
- Drag - the handle affords a swipe-down to dismiss; velocity past a threshold closes it.
- Height - the sheet hugs its content; tall content scrolls inside while the header and footer stay pinned.
- One at a time - never stack sheets; replace the content of the open sheet instead.
- Safe area - the footer reserves the iPhone home-indicator inset.

> **Warning:** Make a sheet non-dismissible (hide the handle and close, ignore scrim taps) only for truly blocking steps - and always give an explicit action to move forward.

### Code examples

### Flutter

```dart
showModalBottomSheet(
  context: context,
  isScrollControlled: true,
  backgroundColor: SyntropyColors.bgBase,
  shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
  ),
  builder: (context) => SyntropyBottomSheet(
    showHandle: true,
    header: SheetHeader(
      title: 'Sheet title',
      subtitle: 'Short description',
      showClose: true,
    ),
    content: SummaryContent(rows: rows),   // swap any content
    footer: SheetFooter(
      primary: Button.primary('Confirm', onPressed: _confirm),
      secondary: Button.secondary('Cancel', onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context)),
    ),
  ),
);
```

### Usage - Do and Don’t

Do

One focused task with a single clear action - a summary plus one primary button.

Don’t

Don’t cram a long form or multi-step flow into a sheet - use a full page or Stepper.

Do

Swap the Content slot to fit the job - here a selectable list - keeping the same chrome.

Don’t

Don’t remove every way out (no handle, no close) unless the step is truly blocking.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** The Content slot is an INSTANCE_SWAP property with the 6 library components as presets. Swap in any component - that is the whole point of the rebuild from the old finite Type list.

> **Warning:** The slot has one shared default across LTR/RTL (a Figma limit). It defaults to the English Text placeholder; for an RTL sheet, swap to the RTL content variant.

> **Tip:** Content is composed from real system components - KeyValue, Input, TextArea, Input Amount, Slider, Tag, Divider, EmptyState - so they stay in sync with their sources.

> **Warning:** The Text link uses brand-colored text, not the Link component: Link needs IBM Plex Sans Arabic, which is unavailable in this environment. Wire it to Link in the full app.
